items.title: Storyboard - Figure Skating Montage
items.summary: Storyboard of a figure skating training montage. Our protagonist strives to get better after a poor showing at a competition, but keeps falling along the way. The montage ends with her regaining her confidence and showing up to the next competition with a smile on her face.
